intro.text: The youngest son of Rivershore's reeve, Matin, and his wife Rema.

items.text: In the life December lived before waking in the past, Kamdon was three when his mother died and twelve when December married his father. Her care gave the drifting boy a purpose, and he went back to his tutoring with fresh energy, though he still refused haircuts and left grubby handprints on clothes until he was sixteen. He grew up, married, and named his son after his own father, but the plague killed him and his whole household.
